title: What's New: Integration with Dynamics 365 Field Service (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Business Central and Field Service Integration
Demo: Service Items and Orders in Business Central
Demo: Work Order Management in Field Service

features.name: Field Service Integration for Projects
features.description: Basic integration between Business Central and Field Service for project management, released in the previous year. Allows synchronization of project-related information between the two systems.
features.status_evidence_quote: Integration between Business Central and field service was already announced and released last year. This was the basic integration for projects.

features.name: Field Service Integration for Service Management
features.description: New integration functionality that extends Field Service integration to include the service model in Business Central, enabling synchronization of service orders, items, and management between the two systems. Requires Business Central premium license.
caveats: Requires Dataverse data sync technology enabled

features.name: Dataverse Data Sync Technology
features.description: The technical foundation for the Field Service integration, enabling real-time synchronization of data between Business Central and Dynamics 365 Field Service through Dataverse with virtual tables.
caveats: Must be enabled in Business Central instance
Virtual tables must be enabled in environment

features.name: Assisted Setup Wizard for Field Service
features.description: A guided setup wizard in Business Central that walks users through the entire process of enabling Field Service integration, including configuration of Dataverse, Sales integration, and virtual tables.

features.name: Field Service Integration App from AppSource
features.description: An extension app that must be downloaded and installed from AppSource to enable all Field Service integration features. It is not installed directly in Business Central by default.
caveats: Must be manually installed from AppSource
Required for all Field Service features

features.name: Service Item Creation and Synchronization
features.description: Automatic creation and synchronization of service items in Business Central based on sales of items, with linked service orders that synchronize to Field Service work orders.

features.name: Work Order Scheduling and Assignment
features.description: Ability to view, schedule, and assign work orders from Business Central service orders in Field Service's schedule board, with drag-and-drop scheduling and employee assignment capabilities.

quotes.text: Integration between Business Central and field service was already announced and released last year. This was the basic integration for projects.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the release history - projects integration was released previously, and services integration is new in 2025 wave 1.
